column2: Chaos is breaking out here and there. It's scattered, and to me none of it seems connected.
I can't tell whether it will drag in this Guild either.
But if the worst happens, you'll all be here. I'm not worried.
True... As long as we don't know how the chaos is connected, worrying too much could even do harm...
Say, Fein. Isn't it about time you settled down?
Someone has to do your work, but by now someone else could take over.
Besides, it'd be reassuring to have you back here. I'm sure the Elder wants that too.
No... there's still something I have to do.
Empire and Alberic
Dead Warlock
Damn it!!! How could this happen?!
Those bastards... the Grand Master?!
Master!!
Fein... the Demon Stone was taken... a single imperial knight... buried everyone in an instant...
That man had a demon sword... one no human should ever hold...
Fein... it seems the legend of the Demon Stone was true...
...Take it back... the Demon Stone, from that man...
Stop the prophecy...
Empire and Alberic (Alberic
Knight
How dare you... the lodge...
Hmph... one of the Guild? I grew tired of cutting down mages in that last fight.
You bastard!!
My sword says it feels ill from drinking too much of your filthy blood...
I leave this man to you.
Sir, Lord Alberic.
You bastard! Running away?!
Hmph, the likes of you aren't worth troubling Lord Alberic over.
You lot... don't expect a single one of you to leave alive!
Assassins
Who's there?!
So it's you lot...
Silent again, I see... But this time won't go like the last.
Assassins (After Battle)
Who gave the order?
You're the Empire's dogs, aren't you?
The Empire... will restore the glory of the Crimson Moon King once more...
We won't let the likes of you get in the way...
Holy City Falls
We're badly outnumbered... no matter how many I cut down, there's no end!
...That's... Serenis?!
Can't you see her? ＄＄＄＄＄＄!
Over there!
Serenis!!
You there, what business have you with Lady Serenis?!
It's me! Recognize me! Serenis!!
Do you want to die?! Insolent wretch!
It can't be... that legend...
Only the chosen, those who have received a holy blessing, can find their way here... Warrior... so you are one of the chosen...
...I don't know whether I was chosen... But I am certainly being guided.
I see... What is your name?
My name is Fein Lu Lugus.
Then, Fein, come here...
You have quite a strong power... I can sense considerable talent.
Fein... the battles ahead of you will surely be extremely hard...{n}
That is true not only of you but of all whom the Angel guides: to fight evil powers, you will need a strong will.
For the enemy targets the weakness in people's hearts. But you must not give in to it.
Diana-sama... do you know the true nature of this evil power?
No. What the Angel does not know, I do not know either.
But I do know the wickedness of the devils who now target this world. And how hard it is for people to fight them...
